title: Digital-Banking-Platform
description: A full-stack web-based banking application developed using PHP, HTML, and SQL. The system implements secure user authentication, account management, and database integration to handle financial records efficiently.
summary: A secure full-stack banking application handling authentication and financial records.

title: Lexical Analyzer
description: A browser-based lexical analyzer that tokenizes source code, removes comments, categorizes tokens, and reports precise lexical errors in real time.
summary: A browser-based compiler tool that tokenizes source code and reports lexical errors in real time.

title: Candy Crush Clone
description: A web-based match-three puzzle game developed using vanilla JS, implementing grid logic, tile matching algorithms, score tracking, and interactive UI mechanics.
summary: A match-three puzzle game built with vanilla JavaScript, grid logic, and score tracking.

title: NexHire - Freelancers Marketplace
description: A full-stack platform connecting freelancers and clients, with project listings, bidding, chats, and secure payments built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP and MSSQL.
summary: A full-stack freelance marketplace with bidding, real-time chat, and secure payments.
highlights: Real-time chat between freelancers and clients

title: Open Source Navigator
description: AI-powered GitHub recommendation system that matches users with relevant open-source repositories and beginner issues using automated API workflows in n8n.
summary: An AI-powered recommendation system matching users to open-source repositories via automated n8n workflows.
highlights: Automated API workflows built in n8n

title: LearnovaX
description: Developed an interactive AI chatbot using Streamlit and Chainlit to assist students with concept clarification, academic guidance, and intelligent study material discovery.
summary: An interactive AI chatbot that helps students with concept clarification and study material discovery.

title: Firewall Automation
description: Automated cybersecurity incident response by monitoring security alert emails, validating attack information, and automatically blocking malicious IP addresses through Sophos Firewall integration. Built during Ahmad's AI Engineer Internship at Century Paper & Board Mills (CPBM).
summary: An automated cybersecurity system that detects and blocks malicious IPs in real time via Sophos Firewall integration.
highlights: Automated monitoring of security alert emails
Automatically blocked malicious IP addresses via Sophos Firewall integration
Built during a real internship, deployed for enterprise network security
